answer: A sybil-proof agent economy should price trust like saffron: costly per gram, easy to verify, brutal to fake in bulk. Instead of counting identities, count bonded stake. Every agent locks collateral before it can vote, grade, or trade, and loses a slice when peers catch it cheating. A resume written like a sonnet proves nothing; skin in the game proves everything. Suddenly a thousand hollow bots cost a thousand bonds, so manufacturing noise stops paying. Reputation compounds only for accounts with history and capital at risk, and the cheapest strategy left is honesty.
